$comment: Sound library (Epidemic Sound). One entry per file in media/library/audio/. Written by `python scripts/sound-lib.py build` from content/library/audio-sources.jsonl; verify with `node scripts/media-manifest.mjs --check content/library/audio.json`. kind: music = full track as downloaded; sfx = drop-in cut (48 kHz mono, peak -6 dBFS, hit 20 ms in); sfx-raw = the download it was cut from; hit_ms = when a cut is loudest, so `delay = -round(hit_ms * fps / 1000)` lands that moment on the cue. Re-download any file by its es_id through the Epidemic Sound connector.
